summary: This directory manages the acquisition and integration of Tokyo Stock Exchange (JPX) market holiday data, providing service layers to fetch and format calendar records for application use.
responsibilities: Fetch market holiday data from external sources
Parse and normalize date strings into standard formats
Provide service layers for holiday data retrieval
Integrate holiday fetcher functionality into the application dependency graph
relationships: The holiday fetcher processes raw market data to produce standardized holiday records.
The service layer abstracts the fetching implementation to allow for consistent dependency injection across the system.
designDecisions: Dependency injection through ZIO layers for service availability
Encapsulation of external data source logic
Separation of parsing and fetching concerns
Use of functional transformations for date normalization
